newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss debt prices ended generally higher but traders said the curve showed signs of steepening, with prices at the long end vulnerable before a Swiss Federal bond auction next week.
The auction tender will be announced on Tuesday and the results of the auction published on Thursday afternoon. Conditions and results also will be available on page SWIW.
"The last few days have been quiet. The long end is more under pressure because of the bond tender," one trader said.
Traders expect the Swiss Treasury to reopen one or more existing bond issues for the latest offering.
Traders saw the federal 4-1/2 percent June 2007 bond CH470458= or the 4-1/4 percent January CH108546= as likely choices for a reopening.
Shorter prices were firmer, helped speculation that the Swiss franc would extend latest gains. -- Friday closing prices as follows:
Dec Conf futures CONFZ6 up 20 at 115.05.
Dec Comi medium-term bond COMIZ6 up 10 at 109.80
Dec Euro Swiss francs FESM6 up six at 97.76.
